# Shri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Astro Center

> A preview of our astrology centre. Explore traditional astrology, Vastu and puja services. Offerings await client approval.

Contact details, location, hours and practitioner information await confirmation.
Languages: Kannada, English (site available at / and /kn/)

## Services
- [Kundli & Horoscope Reading](https://example.com/services/kundli-reading/): A complete reading of your birth chart: strengths, timing and the road ahead.
- [Marriage & Kundli Matching](https://example.com/services/marriage-matching/): Guna milan and a deeper compatibility reading for couples and families.
- [Career & Business](https://example.com/services/career-business/): Timing for job changes, promotions, partnerships and new ventures.
- [Vastu Shastra](https://example.com/services/vastu-shastra/): Vastu for homes, offices and plots, without unnecessary demolition.
- [Dosha Nivarana](https://example.com/services/dosha-remedies/): Mangal, Kaal Sarp, Pitru and Shani doshas, explained calmly and remedied simply.
- [Gemstone Guidance](https://example.com/services/gemstone-guidance/): Which stone, if any, suits your chart, and how to wear it.
